source: ZXNAME0000XZ is also not universal. Some GPUs use GDDR rather than ZXNAME0001XZ. The programming concept to keep stable is device memory: the large off-chip memory backing global allocations and other address spaces. ZXNAME0002XZ is one implementation of that role in many current AI accelerators.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 也不是通用的。某些 GPU 使用 GDDR 而不是 ZXNAME0001XZ。保持稳定的编程概念是设备内存：支持全局分配和其他地址空间的大型片外内存。 ZXNAME0002XZ 是当前许多人工智能加速器中该角色的一种实现。
